title: Add safe branch management
description: Show and manage branches using real Git state, protecting the user's working tree during checkout and deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI lists current/local/remote branches and accurately identifies the checked-out branch and upstream.
Users can create and switch branches; rename/delete operations follow the approved engine and remote policy.
Unsafe checkout or branch deletion is blocked or confirmed without overwriting uncommitted work.
Branch state refreshes in the 2D controls and 3D workspace and is covered by focused tests.

steps.details: Use the architecture decision and existing state contracts.

steps.description: Implement branch list and safe actions
steps.details: Keep branch changes explicit and report verified results.
Cover dirty working tree, current branch deletion, and operation failures.

technicalNotes: Never silently discard or overwrite local modifications.
